description: Drive for water applications, pump control program, over the embedded fieldbus (EFB, Modbus RTU)
source: ABB, ACQ580 pump control program firmware manual, 3AXD50000035867 Rev H (2025-12-30)

sources.title: ACQ580 pump control program firmware manual
sources.note: chapter Additional parameter data and the Modbus parameters of group 58

notes: Embedded fieldbus (terminals on the control unit), 58.01 Protocol enable = Modbus RTU. Defaults: node address 1, 19.2 kbit/s, 8 even 1.
Addresses are 1-based register numbers (400001 = 1). Parameters use 58.33 Addressing mode = Mode 0, the default.

Parameters of type Real are read as 32-bit values (register 420000 + 200 x group + 2 x index) with the FbEq32 scaling of the manual; the 16-bit copies at 400000 + 100 x group + index are scaled differently for several signals and are not in this map.
32-bit values use 58.34 Word order = LO-HI (the default): low word first.
Lists, sources, bit words and data parameters are 16-bit values (400000 + 100 x group + index). Bit words are given as a whole; the bits are in the manual.
Parameters with an index above 99 (for example 58.101 Data I/O 1) are only reachable with addressing mode 1 or 2 and are not in this map. Date, time and duration parameters are not in this map.
Groups 1 to 9 are read-only signals; the other groups are marked read/write, but some parameters are read-only or can only be changed while the drive is stopped (see the manual).
Some units depend on settings: power in kW or hp and torque in N·m or lb·ft, temperatures in °C or °F.
Written from the manufacturer's firmware manual; not tested on a device.
